描述_EN: the term porcelain is applied to ceramics made from a mixture a clay called kaolin and a white stone called petuntse, which was fired at high temperatures. porcelains differ from other ceramics in their impermeability, their whiteness and fine texture. some kilns in the hebei province that produced xing ware came under this control, but were left to continue in their ceramic traditions, producing wares such as this ewer. it shares the xing ware characteristics of a hard, white porcelain body and glaze. xing ware was the earliest true porcelain made in china, and the world. this ewer (left) was made during the liao dynasty, a period when the khitan tribes-people took control of parts of northern china.
描述_ZN: 瓷器一词适用于由一种叫做高岭土的粘土和一种叫做petuntse的白色石头混合制成的陶瓷，在高温下烧制。 瓷器与其他陶瓷的不同之处在于其不渗透性、白色和精细的纹理。 河北省的一些生产邢器的窑场被控制了，但却被留在了他们的陶瓷传统中，生产出了像这个陶器这样的器物。 它具有邢器的特点，即硬而白的瓷体和釉面。 兴器是中国和世界上最早的真正的瓷器。 这个陶器（左）是在辽代制造的，当时契丹人控制了中国北方的部分地区。
